description.fun: Oshawott fights with its 'scalchop', the shell on its belly, made of the same stuff as claws: it blocks attacks with it, slashes back in an instant, and uses it to crack hard berries. If it loses one, a new one grows. It's said to have learned to sharpen it on riverbed stones by watching people use whetstones. Its line follows a samurai's life, from child to young samurai to commander.
description.guide: Oshawott is a Water-type sea otter Pokémon and one of the three first partner Pokémon of Unova, and of Hisui in Pokémon Legends: Arceus. It fights with the scalchop, a shell on its stomach it wields like a blade. It evolves into Dewott and then Samurott, or Hisuian Samurott in Hisui.
description.tagline: A sea otter pup with a seashell sword on its belly.

description.fun: Dewott fights with two scalchops at once, and its flowing technique, honed by strict daily training, can send masters of the blade fleeing. Every Dewott develops its own style, and it never neglects caring for its shells. People are said to have modelled swordplay on its movements, which flow like water. Its Japanese name, Futachimaru, plays on futatsu, 'two', and tachi, a kind of sword.
description.guide: Dewott is the evolved form of Oshawott, a Water-type otter that fights with the two scalchops on its thighs. It trains strictly, and each Dewott develops its own technique. It evolves into Samurott, or into Hisuian Samurott in the Hisui region.
description.tagline: A dual-wielding otter whose swordplay flows like water.

description.fun: Samurott can draw, swing and sheathe the seamitars in its foreleg armour in the blink of an eye, and a single glare is said to silence everyone around it. It leads its group strictly and thrashes anyone who breaks the rules. Designer Yusuke Ohmura went to an aquarium to study otters but was won over by a sea lion show nearby, so it ended up part sea lion.
description.guide: Samurott is the final form of Oshawott, a Water-type Pokémon resembling an armoured samurai sea lion. It draws the seamitar blades from its foreleg armour to strike in an instant. In Hisui it has a Water- and Dark-type regional form, Hisuian Samurott.
description.tagline: A sea-lion samurai with swords in its armour.

description.fun: A hard-hearted rōnin of a Samurott, with black shell armour, wavy whiskers and wave-shaped blades. Unlike Unova's honourable swordsman it uses tricks and cheap shots, its blows crash like ceaseless waves, and the wounds it leaves are said to take years to heal.

note.text: A Dewott that evolves in the harsh land of Hisui, in Pokémon Legends: Arceus, becomes Hisuian Samurott and gains the Dark type.
